title: What Is A Black Start Of The Power Grid?
summary: Practical Engineering explains what a black start is: restarting a power grid after total collapse. It shows why most plants need outside power to start and why rebuilding a synchronized grid is delicate and high-stakes.
why: Go-to reference whenever a major blackout happens, recommended as an excellent explanation of why black starts are hard.

quote.text: Practical Engineering did a really great video a few years ago on why black starts are hard
